description: The shared input hook becomes mandatory without migrating either existing vision component.
trigger: Call Gemma3VisionModel.get_image_embeddings or Mistral3VisionModel.get_image_embeddings with an otherwise valid loaded component and an image that reaches forward.
expected_behavior: Forward the preprocessed image tensor into the first vision module and continue toward an image embedding.
actual_behavior: Both components invoke inherited Model.forward, which calls the new base prepare_inputs and raises NotImplementedError before entering the module loop. The direct caller is Model.forward; Model.prefill has the same dependency on an override if invoked. The inspected multimodal and image-search examples call get_image_embeddings, so they can reach the failure when using an affected component. This does not establish failure of model loading or text-only generation.

verification.description: Searched the full parent tree for hook calls and overrides, then followed the two vision embedding methods into the unchanged forward and the edited base hook.
verification.limits: Literal search does not cover dynamic or external overrides.

verification.description: Ran isolated method bodies with a dummy layer, a no-op inference decorator, and the task's hook replacement applied in memory.
verification.limits: No vision model, checkpoint, PyTorch operation, or image library executed.

introductions.rationale: The base hook first raises here. The two vision subclasses call inherited forward and have no override.
